inputs.inputRule: ZTF g/r/i difference-PSF detections (ALeRCE, Fink, Lasair; one row per exposure) and ATLAS o/c forced-PSF detections, AB, uncertainty <= 0.5 mag

runs.claimBoundary: A phenomenological fit to public difference and forced photometry; it describes the light-curve shape and is not a classification, a physical model or a distance.
runs.notComputedReason: fewer than 8 detections in the fitted bands

parameters.sharedParameters: timing (and the plateau slope s) shared across bands; one amplitude per band

runs.claimBoundary: A phenomenological fit to public difference and forced photometry; it describes the light-curve shape and is not a classification, a physical model or a distance.
runs.notComputedReason: fewer than 8 detections in the fitted bands

parameters.model: F_b(t) = A_b (1 + s(t-t0)) / (1 + exp(-(t-t0)/tau_rise)) for t < t0+gamma; A_b (1 + s gamma) exp(-(t-t0-gamma)/tau_fall) / (1 + exp(-(t-t0)/tau_rise)) after
parameters.sharedParameters: timing (and the plateau slope s) shared across bands; one amplitude per band
